page.layout: One printed page, rotated about 90 degrees on the scan. Main title block in the centre, with a smaller line below it and a volume line at the lower centre. A vertical library stamp runs down the left-centre and is not transcribed.
page.notes: The page is rotated, and the print is very faint, so most lines cannot be read reliably. The legible fragments are "WORKS" in the centre and a short volume line at the bottom. Line lengths for the illegible lines are estimates. The vertical stamp at the left-centre is a library stamp and is left out. Faint marks at the top of the page are show-through or stains and are not transcribed.
